mapper.select: /* TbmAi02Mapper.selectSessionConfirmedItemDescs */ SELECT I.AI_CONFIRM_DESC FROM TB_TBM_SESSION SS INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC ON (SC.CMPNY_CD = SS.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SESSION_CD = SS.SESSION_CD) INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON (M.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD) INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I ON (I.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD) WHERE SS.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND SS.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SS.DEL_YN = 'N' AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' AND I.AI_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND TRIM(IFNULL(I.AI_CONFIRM_DESC, '')) <> '' ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.SORT_IDX

/* TbmAi02Mapper.selectSessionUnconfirmedAiItems */ SELECT M.TITLE AS mtrlTitle , I.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , I.MTRL_DESC AS mtrlDesc , I.AI_STATUS AS aiStatus FROM TB_TBM_SESSION SS INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC ON (SC.CMPNY_CD = SS.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SESSION_CD = SS.SESSION_CD) INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON (M.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD) INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I ON (I.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD) WHERE SS.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND SS.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SS.DEL_YN = 'N' AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' AND I.AI_ANALYZE_YN = 'Y' AND NOT (IFNULL(I.AI_STATUS, '') = 'CONFIRMED' AND TRIM(IFNULL(I.AI_CONFIRM_DESC, '')) <> '') ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.SORT_IDX
